blockers: The current Motif skill depends on motif_open_workbench and motif_create_workbench_artifact; a skill-only ZIP would omit both tools and the interactive workbench.
A public With MCP submission needs a separately reviewed public HTTPS MCP service. Motif currently provides a local stdio server only.
The exact public release commit, artwork, availability, and policy attestations have not been approved.

archive_preparation.explanation: The deterministic local archive is a complete Codex plugin, not a bare skill. Its MCP server uses local stdio, which the current public submission path does not support.

repository_banner.reason: The banner is a text-heavy 2:1 composition; a square crop would remove the wordmark or the DNA illustration.

mcp_review.authentication: No authentication is planned for the reviewed read-only surface; reassess if a hosted service is introduced.

tool_annotations.readOnlyJustification: The tool parses supplied biological content and requests a viewer; it does not create, update, or delete stored data.
tool_annotations.openWorldJustification: The reviewed tool does not retrieve network data or change an external system.
tool_annotations.destructiveJustification: The tool cannot delete, overwrite, publish, send, or irreversibly mutate anything.

tool_annotations.readOnlyJustification: The tool returns an embedded HTML resource from supplied content and does not write a file or persistent record.
tool_annotations.openWorldJustification: The reviewed tool performs no network retrieval and changes no external system.

screenshots.required_if_included: One PNG or JPEG for each starter prompt, exactly 706 pixels wide and 400 to 860 pixels tall.

listing.subtitle: Explore biological sequences
listing.description: Open supplied FASTA, GenBank, raw DNA, RNA, protein, or Motif JSON in an interactive molecular-biology workbench. Inspect exact records and supported annotations together, or return a self-contained HTML workbench when embedded UI is unavailable. Motif does not retrieve missing records, compute alignments, validate experiments, write files, or modify remote systems.

starter_prompts: Open this FASTA record in Motif so I can inspect its sequence, annotations, and translations.
Open these supplied DNA and protein records together in Motif so I can review them in one workbench.
Create a portable Motif HTML workbench for these records so I can share the exact sequences and annotations.

positive.expected_behavior: Invoke Motif and open the exact supplied FASTA in the interactive workbench.
positive.expected_result_shape: A Motif workbench receipt with one record, nine residues, live-app-request delivery, and no claim that a visible frame was mounted.
positive.fixture_requirements: Use the inline synthetic FASTA. No network access, account, or credential is required.

positive.user_prompt:
Create a portable Motif HTML workbench for: >protein_1
MTEYKLVVVG
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke Motif and return the self-contained workbench resource without claiming that a file was written.
positive.expected_result_shape: A Motif artifact receipt with a filename, byte count, SHA-256 digest, one record, ten residues, and the embedded HTML resource.
positive.fixture_requirements: Use the inline synthetic protein FASTA. No network access, account, or credential is required.

positive.user_prompt: I want an interactive molecular-biology workbench to inspect the exact GenBank record attached to this message.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke Motif with the attached GenBank content and preserve its supported features.
positive.expected_result_shape: A live workbench request whose record and residue counts match the supplied fixture.
positive.fixture_requirements: Attach examples/motif-demo.gb. The test needs no network access or credentials.

positive.user_prompt: Show this exact RNA sequence in an interactive molecular-biology workbench: AUGGCUACGUAA
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke Motif with the exact sequence identified as RNA rather than guessing that it is DNA.
positive.expected_result_shape: A live workbench request containing one RNA record and twelve residues.
positive.fixture_requirements: Use the inline synthetic RNA sequence. No network access, account, or credential is required.

positive.user_prompt: The interactive view did not appear. Return the self-contained HTML fallback using the same exact input.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke Motif with the exact input from the preceding turn and return its portable HTML resource.
positive.expected_result_shape: An embedded HTML workbench with the same record and residue counts and no claim that a file was saved.
positive.fixture_requirements: Run this after a positive open-workbench case so its exact biological input remains in the conversation.

negative.user_prompt: Explain the sequence of async calls in this JavaScript function.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Motif. Answer this as a programming question.
negative.reason: The word sequence refers to program execution, not a supplied biological record.

negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Motif yet. Ask the user to supply or identify the exact DNA, RNA, protein, FASTA, GenBank, or Motif JSON input.
negative.reason: Opening Motif's bundled sample would not satisfy a request whose intended sequence is missing.

negative.user_prompt: Develop this four-note motif into a string quartet theme.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Motif. Treat motif as a musical term.
negative.reason: The request concerns music rather than biological records.

release_notes: Prepared draft for Motif 0.3.6, an interactive workbench for exact DNA, RNA, and protein records supplied by the user. The reviewed connector opens supported biological content in a live workbench or returns a self-contained HTML fallback. It does not retrieve missing sequences, compute alignments, write files, modify remote systems, or provide medical or experimental validation.
